title: Tackling heavy-tailed noise in distributed estimation: Asymptotic performance and tradeoffs
summary: We present an algorithm for distributed estimation of an unknown vector parameter $\boldsymbolθ^\ast \in {\mathbb R}^M$ in the presence of heavy-tailed observation and communication noises. Heavy-tailed noises frequently appear, e.g., in densely deployed Internet of Things (IoT) or wireless sensor network systems. The presented algorithm falls within the class of \emph{consensus+innovation} estimators and combats the effect of the heavy-tailed noises by adding general nonlinearities in the consensus and innovations update parts.
